name: Card
description: A surface that groups related content, such as a title, a short text and one action.
whenToUse: Group related content with at most one main action: a project, an article, a setting summary.
Show several items of the same kind side by side, each in its own Card.
whenNotToUse: As a clickable surface: Card has no button role or keyboard handling. Put a link or a Button inside it instead.
For page layout or whole sections: use plain layout elements.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface style: shadow, hairline border or a tint of color.primary.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding and maximum width, from RECIPES.card.sizes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Sets aria-disabled, dims the card to 50% and blocks pointer events.

props.name: children
props.description: The content, styled with cardParts (eyebrow, title, body, action).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the recipe with cn().

states.name: default
states.description: elevated: color.surface with a soft shadow. outlined: transparent with a color.border hairline. filled: color.surface tinted 10% with color.primary.

states.name: hover
states.description: elevated: deeper shadow. outlined: the border turns color.primary. filled: the tint grows to 16%. data-force="hover" pins this state for docs and visual tests.

states.name: disabled
states.description: aria-disabled="true", 50% opacity and no pointer events.

tokens.usage: elevated background, and the base of the filled tint.
Eyebrow and action text, outlined hover border, filled tint, action focus ring.
Corner radius; the action's focus ring uses half of it.
Padding at size sm (the web recipe's p-4 has the same value).
Padding at size md (p-5, same value).
Padding at size lg (p-6, same value).
cardParts.body and cardParts.action text (text-sm, same value).

accessibility.role: article, from the native <article> element. The Card itself is not interactive.
keyboard: The Card is not focusable; Tab reaches the links or buttons inside it.
When disabled, also take inner actions out of the tab order (tabIndex={-1}): aria-disabled and pointer-events do not do that.
accessibility.focus: The action (cardParts.action) shows a 2px color.primary ring on focus-visible. Inner Buttons keep their own ring.
accessibility.contrast: Title and body text at least 4.5:1 against the card background in every variant (WCAG 2.2 AA, 1.4.3).
accessibility.labels: Start the content with a heading (cardParts.title) so the article can be found by heading navigation.

composition: Content goes inside as children, styled with cardParts: eyebrow, title, body and action.
cardParts.action styles a link. A Button can be the action instead, as in the 'One system, every stack' Card, which composes an image, a title and a primary Button.
